title: Add charge parsing and extend tests for GAMESS-US IO
body:
The `GAMESSUS` calculator was added in !1705 (merged in 2020-02-10).
The present MR suggests to (1) add charge parsing to `read_gamess_us_out` and `read_gamess_us_punch` and to (2) extend the tests for these functions.
This improves the coverage up to ~76.5%.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [x] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/contribute.html)
- [~] [**Doc strings** in code changed in this MR are up to date.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code)
- [x] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/tests.html)
- [x] [**Changes** have been added in `changelog.d` using `scriv`.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/writing_changelog.html)
- [~] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)
author: yuzie007
